import os, sys, time
v=os.environ["NODESTEER_PARAM_password"].encode()
limit=int(os.environ["NODESTEER_LOG_LIMIT"])
half=len(v)//2
out_head=b"BEGIN-64K-OUT:"+b"O"*(65536-len(b"BEGIN-64K-OUT:")-half)+v[:half]
err_head=b"BEGIN-64K-ERR:"+b"E"*(65536-len(b"BEGIN-64K-ERR:")-half)+v[:half]
assert len(out_head)==65536 and len(err_head)==65536
sys.stdout.buffer.write(out_head);sys.stdout.flush();time.sleep(0.5)
sys.stderr.buffer.write(err_head);sys.stderr.flush();time.sleep(0.5)
sys.stdout.buffer.write(v[half:]+b"\nAFTER-64K-OUT\nTRUNC-BEGIN\n");sys.stdout.flush();time.sleep(0.5)
sys.stderr.buffer.write(v[half:]+b"\nAFTER-64K-ERR\n");sys.stderr.flush();time.sleep(0.5)
sys.stdout.buffer.write(b"O"*(limit+65536)+b"TRUNC-END\n");sys.stdout.flush()
